name: Santo Domingo
dek: The city station, WMO 78486, not Las Américas. The country sheet uses this same file.
paragraphs: Santo Domingo is WMO 78486, height 14 m, position 18°28′24″N, 69°52′14″W. Las Américas, WMO 78485, is a different file with its own temperature and precipitation. It is the airport station in the submission, and it is not used here.

The average high stays close to 30°C from January through December, with September the highest of those highs. Precipitation is lighter from December through April and heavier from May through November. The country page repeats this station so the capital reference and the city sheet are the same numbers.

climate.caption: Station: Santo Domingo, WMO 78486. Not Las Américas.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Submitted for the Dominican Republic.

season: The National Hurricane Center says the Atlantic hurricane season runs from 1 June to 30 November.
The same page says the Atlantic basin includes the Caribbean Sea.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type A and B, 110 V, 60 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list shows the Dominican Republic at 110 volts and 60 hertz, with plug types A and B. The official tourism site also says the electricity operates at 110 volts. It does not name the plug type or the frequency.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Article 247 of Ley 63-17 is titled as the exceptions to driving on the right, and its first sentence says every vehicle shall be driven on the right half of the carriageway of the public road it is on. The exceptions in that article are overtaking, an obstructed right half, a carriageway too narrow for it, and the lane rules for heavy and slow vehicles on a one-way road with more than one lane.
driving.sourceTitle: Ley 63-17, artículo 247, Dirección General de Impuestos Internos

tipping.label: Tipping
tipping.value: 10% is on the bill; another 10% is customary
tipping.detail: The official tourism site says restaurant bills automatically include a 10% service charge, apart from the 18% sales tax listed as ITBIS, and that it is customary to leave an additional 10% so the server receives a tip. It says taxis do not receive a gratuity, and that a reward is a choice when the service was exceptional or the driver helped.

water.label: Tap water
water.value: Tourism site: do not drink it
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for the Dominican Republic, last reviewed 3 September 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. Under typhoid it says to consider the vaccine if you might travel to areas with poor sanitation and unsafe water, including rural areas. Separately, the official tourism site says tap water is not safe to drink from the tap, not to ingest it from the shower, and to buy bottled water. This page repeats those sentences and does not add medical advice.

sources.sourceTitle: CDC Travelers' Health, the Dominican Republic

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the country as DOMINICAN REPUBLIC (THE). The currency name is Dominican Peso and the code is DOP.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone1970.tab gives the Dominican Republic the single zone America/Santo_Domingo. Punta Cana and Santo Domingo are in that country.
